elements.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
elements.evidence: Section 7.7 expressly states, “Customer shall pay no liquidated damages or penalties under this Agreement.”

elements.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
elements.evidence: No Customer-payable liquidated amount exists because Section 7.7 prohibits all liquidated damages and penalties; therefore, the condition is demonstrably absent.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
elements.evidence: No early-termination fee is payable because all Customer liquidated damages and penalties are prohibited; therefore, the condition requiring a cap is demonstrably absent.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
elements.evidence: No liquidated amount is payable by Customer at all, so there can be no additional liquidated amount beyond an early-termination fee.
